text:
anya: FYI eu-west2 p99 egress jumped from ~120ms to ~380ms in the last 20m. Appears tied to heavy embedding + KV flows from 2 tenants.
sam: Which tenants/racks? any evidence of ToR queue saturation? :eyes:
dmitri: tenant-omega (embeds fanout) + tenant-88 (mini-batch reranks). Rack17/18 show tx_queue_len spikes and eviction churn on the KV shards. NIC drops are low but tx stall time is high.
marisol: Two quick mitigation paths:
A) carve a temporary dedicated slice and steer the two tenants to it (costly but clean isolation).
B) apply a soft rate-limit at the egress proxy for those tenant IDs (token-bucket) to smooth bursts — cheap, quick, but might add tail for some requests.
sam: I prefer B if it buys us time. Less friction (no slice approval) and can be rolled back instantly. We can escalate to A if B doesn't stabilize within 30-60m.
anya: Important: tenant-omega has cross-az callers. If we move them to a slice in-eu-west2-only, we may break latency-sensitive clients. Any plan to keep warm cache affinity?
marisol: For B I'm going to add a per-tenant proxy rule with sticky hashing so origin IPs keep affinity. Also enable KV prefix caching on the proxy for tenant-omega to collapse repeated lookups.
dmitri: Quick risk checklist:
- B: could increase p95 for small sync requests if we under-provision the bucket.
- A: expensive, needs finance signoff if > 2h. Also requires alloc labels and ToR ACL to route through dedicated egress GW.
marisol: Commands I'll run for option B (dry-run first):

```
# apply soft token-bucket via netproxy
netproxyctl rule create --tenant tenant-omega --direction egress --rate 200mbps --burst 50mb --sticky-hash srcip
netproxyctl rule create --tenant tenant-88 --direction egress --rate 120mbps --burst 30mb
# enable prefix caching for tenant-omega
netproxyctl cache enable --tenant tenant-omega --prefix-kv true --ttl 30s
```

sam: If you pick B, ping me to watch gateway BGP + QoS counters. If it doesn't improve in 25-30m, I'll stand up a temp slice. Estimated cost for A: ~€55/hr for p4d-1x equivalent, up to €400 for a multi-hour window.
anya: Please add a CostOps ticket before A; we don't want surprise chargebacks.
dmitri: infra-bot; publish relevant telemetry links?
infra-bot: Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/egress?filter=eu-west2,rack17-18,tenant-omega,tenant-88. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/egress-mitigation (steps for proxy vs slice).
marisol: Rolling out rule B now (dry-run) -> will promote in 90s if no errors.
anya: Thanks. Also let's create an RFC for automatic egress-safe-tiering: when sustained net tx > X for 20m auto-applies proxy token-bucket, and > Y for 30m triggers paid-dedicated offer. dmitri: +1, that would reduce manual ops.
sam: Follow-up item: schedule NIC queue shaping test on canary rack next week (avoid carving slices every day).
marisol: Done. Will report back after 30m window.
anya: Appreciate it. Keeping this thread updated with smoke numbers. :thumbsup:
